title: 60 传经2259 再无牵挂都放下12感谢盟主妖魂未定
slug: 苟在诸天从黑暗佛门开始
lines: “无尽意，观月光宝瓶菩萨摩诃萨，威神之力，巍巍如是。
若有众生多于淫欲，常念恭敬月光宝瓶菩萨，便得离欲；
若多嗔恚，常念恭敬月光宝瓶菩萨，便得离嗔；
若多愚痴，常念恭敬月光宝瓶菩萨，便得离痴。
无尽意，月光宝瓶菩萨有如是等大威神力，多所饶益，是故众生常应心念......”
琉璃寺的香火依然很旺盛。
来时路道的深秋野花也很香。
寒衣坊中妇人牵着女孩的手，跪在那佛像阴影中认真祭拜，虔诚诵经。
今天，她是来还愿的。
她和丈夫李玄于上月来此祈福。
两人说好了，不求外财，只求平安。
可她偷偷瞒着丈夫求了发财。
她求的很虔诚。
她也知道...她的丈夫李玄绝对也没单纯地求平安，保不准儿是求了美人之类。
她年老珠黄，男人么肯定吃着碗里的看着外面的。
如今，李玄中煞了。
不过，也是活该。
他去棉田会耽搁那么久？
谁信？
怕不是和哪个小娘子私会。
只不过糟了煞，被妖魔上了身，那妖魔还真是恐怖，想来是白天才不敢做孽，吓得飞走了。
“多谢菩萨，多谢菩萨！”
孟莹虔诚诵经，还愿。
她真的发财了。
那么一大袋碎银子，足够她带着丫丫过上好生活了。
菩萨真的显灵了！
随后，她又上了三柱清香，她认认真真地插入了香炉中。
香火袅袅。
在慈喜眼前倒映出画面。
慈喜嘴角微勾，然后笑着摇摇头。
五年前，他刚学会观香那会儿，他亲眼看着这妇人和她丈夫来寺中烧香，诵读《月光宝瓶菩萨经》，那时候两人所求的还是福祸与共，共同抵御风雨，祈求菩萨保佑一家平安，可不知何时...平安没了，变成了钱财，美色。
那日，那叫李玄的棉农之所以雨天出去，也不过是被同坊的小娘子勾了勾手指，说了句“人约黄昏，棉田后的小树林见”。
李玄是揣着一腔的欲念去的。
若非如此，他也不会遭煞。
只是...他为什么遭煞？
这两日听闻，说是李玄不仅遭了煞气，还变成了一只恐怖的金翅妖鸟，可那妖鸟出现的太快，离去的也快，根本没多少人看清。
若不是这传闻，慈喜也不会特意去关注一个小小的棉农，也不会被勾起这些回忆，毕竟现在是师尊和玄然师叔争夺衣钵的重要时刻，且慈安这些重要弟子被莫名被烧死。
想着想着...
他缓缓摊开了五指。
content_en:
"With endless intention, I look at the moonlight Aquarius Bodhisattva Mahasattva, whose majestic power is so majestic.
If there are many living beings with lustful desires, and they always recite and respect the Moonlight Vase Bodhisattva, they will be free from lust;
If you are very angry, always recite and respect the Moonlight Vase Bodhisattva, and you will be free from anger;
If you are very foolish and delusional, you will be free from delusion by always reciting the words "Moonlight Vase Bodhisattva".
Inexhaustible intention, Moonlight Aquarius Bodhisattva has such great divine power and is of great benefit, so all living beings should always keep this in mind..."
The incense in Liuli Temple is still very strong.
The late-autumn wildflowers on the road when we arrived were also very fragrant.
The woman in Hanyi Square held the girl's hand, knelt in the shadow of the Buddha statue, worshiped seriously, and chanted sutras devoutly.
Today, she came to fulfill her wish.
She and her husband Li Xuan came here to pray for blessings last month.
The two of them agreed that they would not seek any external wealth, only peace.
But she secretly wanted to get rich without telling her husband.
She prayed very devoutly.
She also knew that...her husband Li Xuan was definitely not just asking for peace, maybe he was asking for a beauty or something.
She is old and pearly, and a man must be eating from the bowl and looking out.
Now, Li Xuan is in trouble.
However, he deserves it.
Will it take him so long to go to the cotton fields?
Who believes it?
I'm afraid it's not a private meeting with some young lady.
It's just that the worst thing is that I was possessed by a demon. The demon was really scary. I guess it was during the day that I didn't dare to do evil, so I was so scared that I flew away.
"Thank you Bodhisattva, thank you Bodhisattva!"
Meng Ying recited sutras devoutly and fulfilled her wish.
She really got rich.
Such a large bag of broken silver is enough for her to live a good life with Yaya.
The Bodhisattva really appeared!
Then, she added three more incense sticks, which she carefully inserted into the incense burner.
————
Incense curls up.
The picture was reflected in front of Cixi's eyes.
Cixi's lips curled up slightly, then she shook her head with a smile.
Five years ago, when he first learned how to watch incense, he watched this woman and her husband come to the temple to burn incense and recite the "Moonlight Aquarius Bodhisattva Sutra". At that time, what the two of them prayed for was to share weal and woe, to weather the wind and rain together, and to pray to the Bodhisattva to protect their family's safety. But I don't know when...the peace was gone and turned into money and beauty.
That day, the cotton farmer named Li Xuan went out on a rainy day because a girl from the same farm hooked his finger and said, "I'll meet you in the woods behind the cotton fields in the evening."
Li Xuan went there filled with desire.
If not, he would not have suffered.
But...why did he suffer?
I heard in the past two days that Li Xuan not only suffered from evil spirits, but also turned into a terrifying golden-winged demon bird. However, the demon bird appeared and left so quickly that not many people saw it clearly.
If it weren't for this rumor, Cixi wouldn't have paid special attention to a small cotton farmer, nor would these memories have been evoked. After all, this is an important moment when Master and Uncle Xuanran are competing for the mantle, and important disciples like Ci'an were burned to death inexplicably.
Thinking about it...
He slowly spread his fingers.
